not_in_this_document: The other 91 WPT schedule lines (for example Milestone satellites, Super Gold Million Mystery Bounty, Seniors, Ladies, High Roller, Big O, PLO 6-Max, NLH Turbo $1,100 on Dec 18, 2-day and 3-day variants at other buy-ins) do not appear in this document. The schedule says 'See structure sheet for details' for them; those per-event sheets were not located on the Wynn poker page or in the linked documents, so their entry terms remain unread.
schedule_day_label_irregularity: The official schedule prints a block as 'Dec. 18 Wednesday'. 18 Dec 2026 is a Friday and 16 Dec 2026 is the Wednesday, so the block is read here as 16 Dec with the printed label kept as-is (see flag F05).
